abilities.critical_success: As success, and the creature is healed by the primal magic, regaining 1d6 Hit Points.
abilities.effect: The hazard rolls initiative as the field of planar warping surges, filling the forest clearing.
abilities.name: Shadowshift
abilities.success: The creature is unaffected and immune to the effect for 24 hours.

traits.name: Primal
traits.text:
This magic comes from the primal tradition, connecting to the natural world and instinct. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to primal magic.

abilities.trigger: A character enters the affected area

hazard.description: Cross-planar see page from the Oaksteward rebels’ ritual causes shadowy warping effects to strain and damage living creatures in the forest clearing.
hazard.disable: DC 17 Arcana (trained) to will the Universe’s hold on the area back into firmness and disable the effect for 1 hour, or *dispel magic* (1st rank; counteract DC 15) to end the effect permanently
hazard.name: Shadowshift Field
hazard.reset: This effect continues for 1 day, after which it ends and cannot be triggered again without another ritual.
hazard.routine: (1 action) Each creature in the clearing must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude save as the planar warping threatens to create microscopic tears inside their body. Fey, plant creatures, and druids are unaffected.
hazard.stealth: +7 (trained) to notice the air and plants wavering and shifting

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.
